name: LMDeploy inter-token latency histogram
notes: InternLM/lmdeploy main, PrometheusStatLogger in lmdeploy/metrics/loggers.py, read 2026-10-04. On by default and requires NO flag: the endpoint is simply available at the API server port (23333 by default). Label keys are model_name and engine on every metric, where engine carries the dp_rank. Bucket construction reuses vLLM's build_buckets / build_1_2_5_buckets idiom. The naming inconsistency inherited from the vLLM fork it tracks: NO unit suffix, so a scraper that filters on '_seconds' drops this series silently. Shares the TPOT bucket list. Observed in record_iteration() from stats.itl.
